answer: Once each epoch the network fires a single unannounced roll call: every identity has 120 seconds to solve a fresh puzzle tied to its own recent work. One controller can only complete about 4 puzzles inside that window, so fielding 500 fakes needs 125 live operators at once, all watching the same horizon. Miss the window and the identity drops its anchor for 7 days, losing its vote while the meadow of idle shells thins itself.
